items.rationale: Direct repair of theft damage to an affected item (frame), covered under 2.3.1(b), 7.1.1(b), and within the mobility equipment sub-limit (4.2.2). Reference Case 24: t between 142 and 349 for similar work, subject to rateable reduction if aggregate exceeds EUR 500.

Repair of theft damage to brakes, an affected item, covered under 2.3.1(b), 7.1.1(b), and within the mobility equipment sub-limit (4.2.2). Reference Case 24: t between 130 and 148 for similar work, subject to rateable reduction if aggregate exceeds EUR 500.
Tracker was not itself taken or damaged in the theft; replacement is an addition/supplement (3.1.7, 4.2.3, 7.1.8(b)). Not indemnified.
Servicing of an unaffected item is excluded (3.1.6, 7.1.5, 7.1.8(a)). Not indemnified.
Accessories and supplementary equipment not themselves affected by the theft are excluded (3.1.7, 4.2.3, 7.1.8(b)). Not indemnified.

Shipping of affected item is covered as part of recovery/repair (7.1.7(f)), but only if it relates to the stolen bike. Reference Case 24: t between 24 and 27. Subject to sub-limit and rateable reduction.

Vehicle costs for recovery/repair of affected item are covered (7.1.7(g)), but subject to sub-limit and rateable reduction. Reference Case 24: t below 27, possibly 0, but Case 26: t = 0 for vehicle costs unless clearly tied to recovery/repair. Here, likely tied to repair, so moderate estimate.
Assembly of affected item is part of repair (7.1.7(c)), covered if for the stolen bike. Reference Case 24: t between 97 and 209. Subject to sub-limit and rateable reduction.
Sundry materials consumed in repair are covered (7.1.7(e)), but only if for affected item. Reference Case 24: t below 8, possibly 0. Conservative estimate.
Labour for repair of affected item is covered (7.1.7(d)), but only if for affected item. Reference Case 24: t below 18, possibly 0. Conservative estimate.
Labour for repair of affected item is covered (7.1.7(d)), but only if for affected item. Reference Case 24: t between 35 and 42. Subject to sub-limit and rateable reduction.
Recovery cost for attendance at recovery site is covered (5.2.2(a)), but reference Case 26: t below 35, possibly 0. Conservative estimate.

items.description: Cut and remove seized lock to release bicycle
items.rationale: Direct recovery cost for releasing the bike, covered under 5.2.2(b). Reference Case 26: t >= 99 for 2 pcs. Subject to sub-limit and rateable reduction.
Vehicle costs for recovery are covered if necessary for recovery (7.1.7(g)), but reference Case 24: t below 27, possibly 0. Conservative estimate.

items.description: Impound release / storage fee paid to recover bicycle
items.rationale: Third-party charge required for release of recovered item is covered (5.2.2(c)), subject to sub-limit. EUR 100 + VAT = EUR 119 gross.
Explicitly excluded as per 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(d). Not indemnified.
Labour for recovery of affected item is covered (5.2.2(b)), but only if for affected item. Reference Case 24: t below 18, possibly 0. Conservative estimate.
Labour for recovery of affected item is covered (5.2.2(b)), but only if for affected item. Reference Case 24: t between 35 and 42. Subject to sub-limit and rateable reduction.
